_about: Number windows on the pump corpus, hand-annotated by the orchestrator (2026-09-19). Coordinates are normalised [0,1] over the EXIF-oriented image; quad corners TL, TR, BR, BL in image space. rotationCW is how far to rotate the image clockwise for the text to read upright (absent = 0). text is what the display SHOWS - zero padding and the comma kept, empty when the window is unreadable. field: total | liters | unitPrice | board (a grade-price board cell that is not the transaction price). Precision: about +-1% of the image edge; the quads are an oracle for a locator, not a pixel-exact mask. Checked by scripts/pump-windows-check.py. Entry-level keys: notOnDisplay - fields expected.csv asserts (from the paired receipt) that the display does not show; csvDisagrees - the display shows a different number than expected.csv asserts, with the reason; legibility on a window - "partial" when the digits are only partly readable through glare. Conventions: no window = the field is not on this display; a window with empty text = found but unreadable; unlit leading cells are never transcribed (no string has a leading space); a board cell can coincide with the transaction price (pump-007, pump-009).
